title: Dov'è mio figlio
overview: Young Sharon is providing election campaign support for her husband Ellis Cameron, who is standing for reelection as mayor of Miami, when their nine-year-old son Tommy is kidnapped at an election event by a Cuban commando unit. Sharon secretly decides to fly to Cuba, where her son is rumored to have been taken. In Havana, Sharon meets Carlos, a German journalist. Carlos and Sharon find each other fascinating from the very start
